notes.title: Patch 1.85, General improvements and user request solved.
notes.notes:
Hi to everybody! Here is the latest patch that improves the game.

Patch to 1.85.00. Version / Valid for PC, Mac & Linux versions
1- Visual guides improved and new ones added.
2- One enemy’s lazy ass weapon didn’t sound at shooting, now fixed.
3- Stabilized de sound track at levels.
4- You also can Shoot with “K” on the keyboard (user requested).
5- Fixed text issues in the story.
6- Removed gnome of the code whom can stole your soul while playing.
7- Centralized ever version of the game at one stable number.

Thanks a lot to eveyone!
Arcanebits

notes.title: Analytics are off the roof, Xbox One Version and Hill 2
notes.notes:
Hi! 
We are happy to say that our Analytics are off the roof. It means a lot to us, we truly believe we can help to make a change.

The ones who wrote about which version (steam vs Xbox One) to purchase? A: I personally may chose the Steam Version, we had to make a ton of adjustments (almost invisible to the end user) but still, there is something in the Steam version that makes it my fav to develop.

On Hill 2, We gave it a go, but we are quite focused into deliver what been promised to Hill 1, and even a surprise, as a way to say thanks for the support!

Cheers and I wish you all, JUST THE BEST!
Arcanebits
